inlines.v: DOGMATIC, DOGMATICAL adjective 1. Pertaining to a dogma, or to settled opinion. 2. Positive; magisterial; asserting or disposed to assert with authority or with overbearing and arrogance; applied to persons; as a dogmatic schoolman or philosopher. 3. Positive; asserted with authority; authoritative; as a DOGMATICAL opinion. 4. Arrogant; overbearing in asserting and maintaining opinions.
